title: Fiscal-context layer (nominal/real, per-capita, FY normalization) + comparison guardrails
context: Misleading fiscal context — presenting nominal figures without noting inflation, comparing across incompatible accounting bases, or mixing fiscal years — causes harm even when every underlying number is correct. The fiscal-context layer applies nominal-to-real conversion (with named deflator and base year recorded as provenance), per-capita normalization, and fiscal-year alignment. Critically, comparison guardrails block or annotate cross-jurisdiction and cross-year comparisons when accounting bases (GASB vs IPSAS), fiscal years, or nominal/real bases differ. Depends on reconcile-007.
objective: Implement the fiscal-context layer (lib/context) that applies nominal-to-real conversion with a named deflator and base year (recorded as provenance), per-capita normalization, and fiscal-year alignment — and implements comparison guardrails that block or annotate cross-jurisdiction or cross-year comparisons when accounting bases, fiscal years, or nominal/real bases differ.
acceptanceCriteria: Applies nominal-to-real conversion using a named deflator series and base year; both the specific deflator series and base year are recorded as provenance alongside every real-terms figure
Per-capita normalization applied where used, with the population source and retrieval date recorded as provenance
Fiscal-year alignment implemented: data spanning different fiscal years is explicitly aligned or flagged, never silently compared

Comparison guardrails: cross-jurisdiction and cross-year comparisons are blocked or annotated when accounting bases (e.g., GASB vs IPSAS), fiscal years, or nominal/real differ; tested on fixture cases
The system never conflates budgeted with actual in fiscal context presentation
Reviewed and signed off by the public-finance expert; PR merged with green CI and maintainer review passed
output: A merged PR containing the fiscal-context layer (lib/context) with nominal-to-real conversion (provenance-recorded deflator and base year), per-capita normalization, fiscal-year alignment, and comparison guardrails blocking or annotating incompatible cross-jurisdiction/cross-year comparisons.
